title: Preserving Cultural Identity with Context-Aware Translation Through Multi-Agent AI Systems
benchmark_measurement: Culturally sensitive translation of religious texts and traditions, including descriptions of festivals (Diwali), rituals (Ganga Aarti, Sema Ceremony), and weekly observances (Shabbat).
findings: The paper's multi-agent framework produced more culturally and spiritually nuanced translations of religious texts compared to GPT-4o. It successfully incorporated specific religious observances (e.g., Shabbat candles, Kiddush in Judaism) and spiritual terminology (e.g., 'mystical' and 'divine' for Sufi traditions) that were often generalized or omitted by GPT-4o, thus better preserving the ritualistic and emotional depth of the religious content.
